answer: A single nectar checkpoint reconciles every slash, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while the payoff does not. Forging 157 aliases thus costs 86 bonds held for 16 days each, plus the willow attestations those aliases can never earn. Each identity must lock a bond, called a raven, before it can post or attest. Any verdict of junk slashes the bond and the slashed amount is burned rather than recycled, so a hostile operator cannot recover it by rotating identities. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
